title: Blue bus first seen
detail: 18 m before the impact point, moving at 12 km/h (5.2 s before impact).

title: Peak speed 19 ± 5 km/h
detail: Blue bus was at its fastest 4.7 s before impact. Uncertainty comes from the road calibration (±15%).

title: Traffic constable on duty: line of sight
detail: Clear view of Blue bus throughout the last 3.1 s before impact.

title: Shopkeeper: line of sight
detail: View of Blue bus blocked for 2.3 of the last 3.1 s before impact (mostly by White car).

title: Could it have stopped?
detail: 1.6 s before impact Blue bus was at 11 km/h with 4.7 m to go. A full stop (1 s reaction + braking) needs 3.6 m. A stop was possible; the highest speed that would have allowed a stop is about 37 km/h.

title: Braking began 1.5 s before impact
detail: At 10 km/h with 4.4 m left to the impact point. Braking alone needs about 0.5 m to stop from that speed, so a stop was possible.

title: Motorcyclist: line of sight
detail: View of Blue bus blocked for 1.5 of the last 3.1 s before impact (mostly by Grey motorcycle).

title: Closest approach: Grey motorcycle
detail: Grey motorcycle came within 0.9 m of Blue bus's body (1.9 m centre to centre) at T+0.0 s.

title: Closest approach: Policeman
detail: Policeman came within 1.5 m of Blue bus's body (2.5 m centre to centre) at T+1.6 s.

title: Blue bus at rest
detail: It travelled 2.8 m after the impact and stopped 8.6 s later.
